questions.question: What does the passage say about the value of this treatise even though it has some difficulties?
questions.answer: It says the treatise is still very important.

questions.question: Which honored person is said to have foreseen this work?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What two names did he give to this work?
questions.answer: He called it the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: How did Imam Ali treat this part of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: He gave it special attention and pointed people toward it.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Supreme Sign explains?
questions.answer: It explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: Besides being called the Supreme Sign, what numbered part of the Risale-i Nur is it?
questions.answer: It is the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How is the Seventh Ray connected to the name Staff of Moses?
questions.answer: The passage says the Imam used that name for the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What are the three main parts of this treatise?
questions.answer: An Introduction, a First Station, and a Second Station.

questions.question: What does the Introduction include?
questions.answer: It includes four important matters.

questions.question: What is found in the First Station?
questions.answer: The Arabic part of the explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What is found in the Second Station?
questions.answer: The translation of that explanation and the proofs that go with it.

questions.question: Why does the speaker say the Introduction became so long?
questions.answer: Because there was a real need for that much explanation.

questions.question: What surprising opinion might some people still have about the Introduction?
questions.answer: Some may think it is still too short.

questions.question: What main message is given in the Qur’an verse at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings and jinn were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: What is one main idea of the first paragraph of the passage?
questions.answer: Even with its hard parts, the book is presented as very important.

questions.question: What does it mean that Imam Ali “foresaw” this work?
questions.answer: It means he was said to know about it before it was written.

questions.question: Why are the names given by Imam Ali important in the passage?
questions.answer: They show honor and special value for the treatise.

questions.question: What does the passage show by saying he directed people’s gaze toward it?
questions.answer: It shows that people should pay attention to it.

questions.question: How does the passage connect the Supreme Sign with the Supreme Verse?
questions.answer: It says the treatise is a true explanation of that verse.

questions.question: What second title is linked with the Seventh Ray?
questions.answer: Staff of Moses.

questions.question: If a student wanted the Arabic explanation, which part should the student read?
questions.answer: The First Station.

questions.question: If a student wanted the translated explanation with evidence, which part should the student read?
questions.answer: The Second Station.

questions.question: What is the job of the Introduction?
questions.answer: It presents four important matters before the two Stations.

questions.question: Did the speaker plan from the start to make the Introduction very long?
questions.answer: No. He says that was not his plan.

questions.question: What does the long Introduction suggest, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It suggests that people needed that much explanation.

questions.question: What two groups are named in the Qur’an verse?
questions.answer: Jinn and mankind.

questions.question: According to the verse, what is their purpose?
questions.answer: Their purpose is to worship Allah.

questions.question: What problem from earlier is mentioned at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The book has flaws and is hard in some ways.

questions.question: What is the response to that problem in the same sentence?
questions.answer: In spite of that, the treatise is said to have great importance.

questions.question: Who is the respected figure mentioned with a prayer for Allah’s pleasure?
questions.answer: Imam Ali.

questions.question: What does the passage say Imam Ali did about this treatise?
questions.answer: He predicted it and gave it special names.

questions.question: Name one of the titles given to the treatise.
questions.answer: Supreme Sign.

questions.question: Name the other title given to the treatise.
questions.answer: Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What can we infer from the passage about how the Imam viewed this work?
questions.answer: He viewed it very positively and as worthy of attention.

questions.question: What kind of relation does the treatise have to the Supreme Verse?
questions.answer: It serves as an explanation of it.

questions.question: What number identifies this Ray in the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It is the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How many major divisions does the treatise have?
questions.answer: Three major divisions.

questions.question: What are those three divisions?
questions.answer: The Introduction, the First Station, and the Second Station.

questions.question: What does the First Station have that the Second Station does not?
questions.answer: The First Station has the Arabic explanation itself.

questions.question: What does the Second Station add for readers?
questions.answer: It gives the translation and supporting proofs.

questions.question: What lesson about writing can we learn from the comment on the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: Sometimes a writer explains more because readers truly need it.

questions.question: What is the central duty mentioned in the final verse quoted here?
questions.answer: Worshipping Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, should the treatise be ignored because it is difficult?
questions.answer: No. It should still be valued because it is described as highly important.

questions.question: Which person from early Islam is named as honoring this work?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What action shows that he honored it in a special way?
questions.answer: He gave it special names and pointed people toward it.

questions.question: What are the two names mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Supreme Sign and Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What does the phrase “true exposition” tell us about the treatise’s role?
questions.answer: It tells us the treatise is meant to clearly explain the verse.

questions.question: The passage says the work is also the Seventh Ray. What does that tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us this treatise is one part of a larger collection.

questions.question: How is the treatise organized?
questions.answer: It is organized into an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What is covered in the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: Which Station is in Arabic?
questions.answer: The First Station.

questions.question: Which Station helps readers by giving the meaning in another language and adding evidence?
questions.answer: The Second Station.

questions.question: Why is the Introduction longer than the speaker first intended?
questions.answer: Because there was a need to explain more.

questions.question: Why might some readers still want more, even after a long Introduction?
questions.answer: Because the topic matters a lot and they may want fuller explanation.

questions.question: What does the verse at the end teach about why jinn and humans were created?
questions.answer: They were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: What contrast appears at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The treatise has some weaknesses, but it is still described as very important.

questions.question: Who is said to have known about this work before it was written?
questions.answer: Imam Ali.

questions.question: What can we understand from his giving the work names?
questions.answer: It shows the work has special honor and meaning.

questions.question: Which title points to greatness or high rank?
questions.answer: Supreme Sign.

questions.question: Which title connects the work with Prophet Musa’s staff?
questions.answer: Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What does the passage say Imam Ali did for people besides naming the work?
questions.answer: He drew people’s attention to it.

questions.question: What is being explained by this treatise?
questions.answer: The Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What is another way the passage identifies this treatise inside the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It identifies it as the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How many sections are named in the treatise’s plan?
questions.answer: Three sections are named.

questions.question: Which section comes first, before the two Stations?
questions.answer: The Introduction.

questions.question: What does the Introduction contain?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: Compare the two Stations. What is the main difference between them?
questions.answer: The First Station has the Arabic explanation, while the Second Station gives its translation and proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about his intention for the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: He says he did not mean to make it that long.

questions.question: What reason is given for its length?
questions.answer: The length shows there was a need for it.

questions.question: According to the quoted verse, what should jinn and people do?
questions.answer: They should worship Allah.

questions.question: What does the opening sentence teach about judging this treatise?
questions.answer: We should not judge it only by its difficulties, because it also has great worth.

questions.question: Which noble companion is mentioned in connection with this treatise?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What two titles are attached to the treatise in the passage?
questions.answer: Supreme Sign and Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Imam Ali’s attitude toward this part of the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: He favored it in a special way.

questions.question: What effect did that special favor have on people?
questions.answer: It directed their attention to this work.

questions.question: In simple words, what does the treatise do with the Supreme Verse?
questions.answer: It explains the verse.

questions.question: What number is given to this Ray?
questions.answer: Seven.

questions.question: What does the treatise consist of?
questions.answer: It consists of an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: How many important matters are in the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four.

questions.question: What language is used in the First Station?
questions.answer: Arabic.

questions.question: What two things are included in the Second Station?
questions.answer: A translation of the explanation and proofs that support it.

questions.question: What does the speaker admit about the Introduction?
questions.answer: He admits that it explains a lot and became longer than he planned.

questions.question: What does the speaker believe the long Introduction shows?
questions.answer: It shows that such length was needed.

questions.question: How might readers react differently to the same Introduction?
questions.answer: Some may think it is too long, and others may think it is not long enough.

questions.question: What is the message of the Qur’an verse placed at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah created jinn and human beings to worship Him.
